moneyCosts.title: Costs
moneyCosts.sub: The month's fixed costs and the daily cost lines the shop sends the ERP with its daily summary.
moneyCosts.notLinked: Costs go to the ERP from the day this store switches to the new ERP contract (v6). Until then nothing here can be entered or sent.
moneyCosts.readOnly: You can see the costs. Entering them needs the "Set fixed costs" or the "Enter daily cost lines" permission.
moneyCosts.fixedLocked: You can enter and reverse the daily cost lines. The month's fixed costs and the lines this shop never has need the "Set fixed costs" permission.

fixed.title: Fixed costs
fixed.sub: Salary, rent, utilities and other costs of a whole month. The ERP spreads them over the days of the month, exact to the paisa, with the remainder on the last day. They never go into a day's other costs.
fixed.notePh: For example: salary raised from this month
fixed.saved: Saved as version {n}. It goes to the ERP within a minute.
fixed.same: Nothing changed: these are already the month's numbers.
fixed.fromLast: Filled in from {month}. Check every line, then save.
fixed.empty: Not set yet. Write each line; write 0 for a cost the shop does not have.
fixed.needAll: Write every line as an amount (0 for none).

lines.title: Daily cost lines
lines.sub: Costs of one day that go into that day's summary: packaging, accessories, payment and COD fees, courier, ads and other. Enter them for today or an open day; an earlier day already sent goes to the ERP again by itself.
lines.addedResent: Added. The day's summary was built again and goes to the ERP.
lines.badAmount: Write the amount (0 means none that day).
lines.none: No cost entered for the open days yet.
lines.reversedOk: Reversed. Enter the right amount again if needed.
lines.neverTitle: Cost lines this shop never has
lines.neverSub: A ticked line counts as 0 on days with no entry, instead of "not in yet".

err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the permission for this.
err.BOOKS_NOT_LINKED: The books with the ERP have not started for this store yet.
err.BOOKS_DAY_CLOSED: That day or month is no longer open in the books.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is not filled in right. Check the amounts and the day; an amount far above the usual is refused as a typing slip.
err.CONFLICT: This cannot be reversed (already reversed, a reversal, or from a statement).
err.NOT_FOUND: That entry is not there any more. Open the page again.

moneyCosts.never: Nothing here moves money. A cost is never changed or deleted: a wrong one is reversed and entered again.

fromStatements.d: The courier's charges and the gateways' fees written by the statements you import, so nobody types them. Off: enter them by hand on the Courier and Payment and COD fees lines.
fromStatements.courier: Courier charges from the COD statement
fromStatements.courierHelp: When a courier's COD statement is imported (Money › COD), the charges it deducted become one Courier cost on the day of the import. Stop entering the courier's charges by hand when this is on, or they count twice.
fromStatements.gateway: Gateway fees from the gateway statement
fromStatements.gatewayHelp: When a gateway's statement (bKash, Nagad, card) is imported, its fees become one Payment and COD fees cost on the day of the import. Stop entering those fees by hand when this is on, or they count twice.
fromStatements.readOnly: You can see these settings. Changing them needs the "Set fixed costs" permission.

err.STALE: Someone changed these settings meanwhile. The page now shows their values; check them and save again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is not filled in right.
err.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to change these settings.
err.forbidden: You are not allowed to change these settings.
err.network: No connection. Nothing was saved; try again.
err.other: It could not be saved. Try again.

staff.title: Salaries and monthly costs
staff.sub: Each person's salary and each monthly bill, with the amount from a month on. Change an amount from a month: earlier months keep the old figure.
staff.none: Nobody added yet. Add a person or a monthly bill (rent, internet).
staff.fromHelp: Earlier months keep their old amount.
staff.filled: The fixed costs below are filled from the list. Check them, then press Save there.
staff.needAll: Write a name, an amount, a month and a pay day from 1 to 28.
staff.needAmount: Write an amount and a month.
staff.note: Nothing is paid from here. Use for a month only fills the form above; saving that form is what records the month.

err.STALE: Someone changed this list. The page is read again; please try once more.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something in the list is not valid, or a saved person or amount was removed (stop a person instead).
err.FORBIDDEN: You may not change this list.
err.forbidden: You may not change this list.
err.other: The list was not saved. Try again.
err.NOTHING_TO_PAY: Nobody is left to pay this month.
err.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Try later.
err.PIN_NOT_SET: Set your PIN in Settings first.
err.CASH_OFF: Money in & out is switched off.
err.MONTH_PAID: This month is already paid for that person.

staff.adjustHelp: For the month picked above only. Net to pay = the amount + bonus - deduction - advance. The month's cost counts the bonus and the deduction; an advance only moves the day the money goes. Nothing is paid from here.
staff.slipBlocked: The browser blocked the pay slip window. Allow pop-ups for this page and try again.
staff.payNote: Each salary goes into Money in & out as a cost at once. Nothing is sent to the person. A wrong payment is reversed in Money in & out, never deleted.
staff.paidLocked: This month is paid: its advance, bonus and deduction are locked.
staff.payNone: Nobody is left to pay this month.

tile.perOrderNone: No delivered order yet this month.
tile.perOrderSub: About {n} deliveries this month at this pace. More orders = smaller share.

fc.note: These are the shop's own staff and costs. Every amount goes into the month's fixed costs. An advance, bonus or deduction is always a new row, never an edit; paying and rows need your PIN.
fc.saved: Saved. Earlier months keep their old amount.
fc.rowAdded: Row added. The net to pay is updated.
fc.rowCancelled: Row cancelled with a new row. Nothing was deleted.

sal.title: Salaries
sal.sub: Tap the pencil for an advance, bonus or deduction, a salary change and its history. Paying needs your PIN.
sal.none: Nobody added yet. Add a person to start the salary list.

fc.salCost: Salary cost this month (with bonus and deductions)

oth.title: Other fixed costs
oth.sub: Rent, utilities and other bills. A change asks "from which month?" and keeps the old amount for earlier months.
oth.head: Cost head
oth.none: No monthly cost added yet. Add a cost head (rent, internet).

trend.title: 6-month trend
trend.legend: Dark = salaries, light = other fixed costs.

hist.title: Amount history
hist.help: Each month uses the amount that was set for it. Changing today never rewrites a past month.

p.noRows: No advance, bonus or deduction this month.
p.locked: Paid {amount} on {date}. This month is locked.
p.newRow: Add a row for this month
p.advanceHelp: An advance goes out of the cashbook account at once and comes off the salary. A wrong advance is reversed in Money in & out.
p.rowHelp: A bonus or deduction changes the net to pay. A wrong one is cancelled with a new row, never edited.

chg.title: Change amount
chg.now: Now {amount} a month. Earlier months keep their old amount.
chg.help: The change is saved with your name and today's date.

err.TOO_BIG: That is more than this month pays.
err.ACCOUNT_NEEDED: Pick the account the advance comes from.
err.ADVANCE_IN_CASHBOOK: An advance was paid from the cashbook. Reverse it in Money in & out.
err.NOT_FOUND: That person or row was not found.

fc.moreSub: The month's fixed costs form, the list the way it was, the daily cost lines and the costs from statements.

bud.title: Budgets this month
bud.sub: Day {day} of {days}. "At this pace" spreads what is spent so far over the whole month.
bud.noneSet: No budget set yet. Press "Edit budgets" to give each cost a monthly budget.

exp.title: Other expenses
exp.none: No expense this month or last month.

ads.title: Ad spend (imported every day)
ads.none: No ad spend imported for this month or last month.
ads.rate: Paid by card in US dollars. Rate used: 1 USD = {rate} {currency}.
